description: Harness targets for the harness-agnostic install of SMard Agent Flow. Destinations use ~ for the user profile. Every target honours the install contract: copy, verify by hash, never remove what is not ours, back up what differs, refuse a foreign destination. Evidence of each format was verified on a real Windows machine before listing.

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.note: Canonical plugin route. Uses plugin/install.ps1 from the same package.

harnesses.note: One self-contained skill 'smard-agent-flow' in the user skills directory.
